what_happened: The separating model was not merely stated at report level: a compiled, sorry-free probe at specs/evidence/lcu-lcn-separation/lcu-lcn-separating-model.lean machine-checks the whole chain, ending in the headline theorem lcU_not_extDerivable_base. Cheap because Semantics/Frames/Standard.lean's translationFrame, PlusDeterminism's stab_iff_of_deterministic, and Deterministic/Validity's PlusValidDetIn + plusValidDetIn_reflectTime already existed; only the dstab sibling of the collapse and a 10-line soundness transcription had to be written.

This is dispatch_seq 3 for task 906, yet the task directory contained only .dispatch/3.md on entry: no reports/, no .return-meta.json, no partial notes from dispatches 1 and 2. Nothing had to be redone (the research is self-contained), but the two earlier dispatches are unaccounted for.

Plan-time live-state check found the research dispatch's compiled probe at specs/evidence/lcu-lcn-separation/lcu-lcn-separating-model.lean is UNTRACKED by git (git status reports '?? specs/evidence/lcu-lcn-separation/') and absent from scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh's WIRED array, unlike the precedent probe specs/evidence/limit-closure-schema/lc-schema-omega-chain.lean which is both tracked and wired. The research postflight commit d7bf732fb did not pick it up. Per check-evidence-probes.sh's TRACKED-NOT-MERELY-PRESENT contract the probe would be absent from a fresh clone and rot unwatched. Scheduled as explicit phase work in the plan rather than left implicit.

The research dispatch compiled every declaration this plan lands, so plan authoring was transcription-and-scoping work rather than design work: all five Lean signatures were lifted verbatim from specs/evidence/lcu-lcn-separation/lcu-lcn-separating-model.lean into the plan's Lean Challenge Statements section, and no proof strategy had to be invented. The report's own Finding 5 (nearly all machinery already existed) carried straight through to the plan's effort estimate.

Phase 1's Risk table anticipated dstab_iff_of_deterministic's axiom profile might not be [propext]-only. Measured via mcp__lean-lsp__lean_verify (cross-checked against stab_iff_of_deterministic measuring [propext] on the same tool): the real profile is [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. The plan's pre-written two-branch mitigation applied cleanly with no improvisation needed -- the non-propext branch's instructions (keep the four-name claim unwidened, record the fifth on its own line with the cost named, scope the Why-this-is-choice-free section) were followed exactly as written.

Plan task 1.4 instructed a 'Paper: anchor line matching the shape used by the module's neighbours', but PlusDeterminism.lean's actual four existing per-declaration docstrings carry no separate Paper: line at all -- only inline paper-label citations. Matched the module's actual shape instead of the literal instruction; recorded as a progress-file deviation and plan-checklist annotation rather than silently deviating.

While updating FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/README.md's PlusLCSchema.lean inventory row, briefly hand-edited the generated line-count cell (490 -> 532) before re-reading Phase 1's own precedent annotation ('never of a generated count cell') and reverting it to 490 before commit. No bad state was committed; caught during the same edit pass.

Phase 2's docstring additions (non-derivability verdict, .Dense/.RTime extension, .ZTime position, guarded-until-form note, derivability-vs-validity distinction) landed cleanly on the first edit pass with the scoped build green and typst-sync-check.sh clean after one --fix pass; all five pre-existing 'open and unclaimed' sites were confirmed textually unchanged by grep before and after.

Phase 3 transcription of lcAnte_iff_lcCons_of_deterministic hit the plan's own pre-flagged Risk: the probe's inline 'show' tactic (exploiting lcAnte/lcCons's definitional unfolding) is linted under --wfail per plan-authoring-gate-collisions.md Condition 8. Resolved per the plan's own pre-authorized remedy: added two named rfl lemmas (lcAnte_eq_stab, lcCons_eq_dstab) and rw through them instead of 'show'. No signature change, proof content otherwise verbatim.

check-module-invariants.sh --no-build reports FAIL INV (stale generated inventory block in FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md, FormalSystem/PlusLanguage/README.md, README.md) during Phase 4's verification run. This is pre-existing residue from Phase 3's growth of LCExtension.lean (not caused by Phase 4's docs/theorem-index.md edit) and is explicitly Phase 5's own task (--emit-inventory regeneration), named in the plan's Phase 5 task list. Not acted on in Phase 4; left for Phase 5.

git-commit-phase.sh --objective '1-3' (a combined range) did not match any single integer objective id in phase-5-progress.json, so files_touched derivation returned empty and the probe file plus check-evidence-probes.sh were silently excluded from the phase commit (WARNING printed, commit still succeeded with only fixed task-dir paths). Recovered with a direct git-commit-scoped.sh follow-up commit naming both files explicitly. Lesson: pass one objective id per git-commit-phase.sh call, never a combined range, when objectives were completed together.
